questions.text:
Simplify mentally:
   \[
   \frac{1-\sin x}{\cos x}+\frac{\cos x}{1-\sin x}.
   \]

If
   \[
   \tan\theta+\sec\theta=7,
   \]
   find the exact value of
   \[
   \tan\theta-\sec\theta.
   \]

For acute \(\theta\), suppose
   \[
   \sin\theta+\cos\theta=\frac{5}{4}.
   \]
   Find the exact value of
   \[
   \tan\theta+\cot\theta.
   \]

Let
   \[
   E=\frac{\sin^4 x-\cos^4 x}{\sin^2 x-\cos^2 x}+\frac{1}{\sec^2 x}+\frac{1}{\csc^2 x}.
   \]
   Determine the constant value of \(E\).

questions.text:

$\log_{2}(\tan 1^\circ) + \log_{2}(\tan 2^\circ) + \log_{2}(\tan 3^\circ) + \dots + \log_{2}(\tan 89^\circ)$

questions.text: Suppose $x$ is an angle in the interval $(0, \pi)$ such that $\csc x - \cot x = 5$. Determine the exact value of $\cos x$.
